decision.summary: A multi-sample upward offset begins in N and U around index 480–485, with E lagging by ~5 samples; all three axes show coherent motion consistent with a transient platform. The offset persists through index 529, after which the signal plateaus or partially recovers (530–540) but does not clearly return to pre-event levels before the end of the allowed context (579). Due to absence of a confirmed opposing return, the interval is classified as uncertain.

intervals.observation: N and U rise together from ~480–485, sustained through 529; E shows delayed but coherent upward shift starting ~485–490. Return not observed before 530; at 530–540 the trend flattens or slightly declines but does not revert to pre-event baseline. No opposing return confirmed within allowed context.
